Hi Lucas,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear your order SO-15940 arrived late and with a damaged carton. That's not the experience we want you to have.

I've flagged this with our team so we can look into what happened with the delivery delay and the damaged carton. We'll follow up shortly with next steps, which may include a replacement for the damaged items or another resolution.

If you have photos of the crushed carton or any other details that would help us investigate, please reply to this message and we'll take care of it.

Thanks for your patience,
Owen Castillo
Northwind Analytics Support
